text:
A liquid is heated and it expands.
How does this lead to the formation of a convection current?
A
The density of the heated liquid decreases.
B
The density of the heated liquid increases.
C
The mass of the heated liquid molecules decreases.
D
The mass of the heated liquid molecules increases.

options.label: A
options.text: The density of the heated liquid decreases.

options.label: B
options.text: The density of the heated liquid increases.

options.label: C
options.text: The mass of the heated liquid molecules decreases.

options.label: D
options.text: The mass of the heated liquid molecules increases.
